title: Lil Uzi Vert, Playboi Carti & Baby Keem to Headline Chicago’s Summer Smash 2026 as North West Sets Festival Debut
summary: The festival is slated for June 12-14 at Seatgeek Stadium.
contentText:
Lyrical Lemonade’s Summer Smash 2026 is returning to Chicago in June, and the festival revealed its lineup on Monday (April 13), which boasts Lil Uzi Vert, Playboi Carti and Baby Keem as headliners for the three nights.

The festival is slated for June 12 through June 14 at Seatgeek Stadium and tickets will be on sale starting on April 14 at 2 p.m. local time. General passes for all three days are priced at $399.

Uzi will helm Friday night (June 12), which will also see the festival debut of North West, along with Chief Keef, Molly Santana, G Herbo and Lucki.

Saturday night (June 13) boasts Baby Keem, along with Skrillex, Yung Lean, 2Hollis, Waka Flocka Flame, Feng and Xaviersobased. Playboi Carti and Lil Baby are slated to take over Sunday’s (June 14) edition to close out the festival, and they’ll be joined by Fetty Wap, EsDeeKid, BigXthaPlug and Che.

“This will be the best one yet,” Lyrical Lemonade founder Cole Bennett promised in a post to social media. “I actually still can’t believe we pulled this off.. & yes, the flyer was made by hand. Swipe over to see the process. SEE YOU ALL IN JUNE, CHICAGO.”

In addition to performances across three stages, there will be activations, a range of food options and carnival rides like a Ferris wheel for fans to enjoy.

The Summer Smash lineup continues to extend its Midwest footprint. 2025’s festival saw performances from YEAT, Don Toliver, Future and Young Thug.
